model_output.verdict: A certified elementary teacher with classroom results and grade-level leadership a recruiter can readily see.
write_up: Your resume makes a strong case for 4th Grade Teacher roles: you show the classroom you teach, reading growth, and the work you do with other teachers. The numbers give a recruiter something concrete to carry away!

The reading assessment line is your best: it names the measure, the starting point, and the improvement over three years. Your certification and English Language Learner endorsement also sit where a recruiter can find them. The family literacy night line is another good model for naming the work and who it reached.

Add what you contributed to the behavior support committee, then consider moving the reading result to the top of your current role. Your resume isn't likely to be the thing standing between you and a callback; how competitive a teaching opening is matters too.
